business_summary: Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells wine, brandy, and sparkling wine in China, France, Spain, Chile, and Australia. The company operates under the Changyu, Noble Dragon, AFIP, Longyu, Long Tailed Cat, Golden Icewine Valley, Zenithwirl, Vermouth, Rena, Baron Balboa, Donelly, Atrio, Kilikanoon, IWCC, Koya, Liquan, Mminni, Pagese, Roullet Fransac, and other names. It is also involved in grape growing and acquisition, and travel resource development activities. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Yantai, China. Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Yantai Changyu Group Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국, 프랑스, ​​스페인, 칠레 및 호주에서 와인, 브랜디, 스파클링 와인을 생산 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 Changyu, Noble Dragon, AFIP, Longyu, Long Tailed Cat, Golden Icewine Valley, Zenithwirl, Vermouth, Rena, Baron Balboa, Donelly, Atrio, Kilikanoon, IWCC, Koya, Liquan, Mminni, Pagese, Roullet Fransac 및 기타 이름으로 운영됩니다. 또한 포도 재배 및 획득, 여행 자원 개발 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1997년에 설립되었으며 본사는 중국 옌타이에 있습니다. Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Company Limited는 Yantai Changyu Group Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
